description: Codewhale and Momentic's Mo through their npm names, each run only as `--version`.
why: Each CLI is run only as `--version`, so each npm package is its agent's only witness and removing it from the catalog turns must_find red; forbid_evidence holds ~/.codewhale absent after both the install and `codewhale --version`, so a release that starts writing it on either fails here rather than adding a second witness unseen. deepseek-harness is forbidden because Codewhale started as deepseek-tui and defaults to DeepSeek's models; claude-code and codex-cli because npm globals are their route too.
known_gaps: Mo's curl installer, cli.momentic.ai/qa, writes ~/.local/bin/qa and nothing else a query reads (probe run 45238894100). The catalog declines that name, so an install made that way is not found.
